summary: VerifyMe, Inc. (Nasdaq: VRME) completed its merger with Cayman-incorporated Open World Ltd. on September 30, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET, per an Agreement and Plan of Merger originally signed February 11, 2026. Merger Sub merged into Legacy OpenWorld, which survived as a wholly owned VerifyMe subsidiary, and the combined company became digital-asset/blockchain focused, renaming to OpenWorld, Inc. effective October 1, 2026. A 1:10 reverse split preceded closing. The filing cites no price, premium, or advisor. Watch for share-count overhang, Nasdaq compliance, and post-close governance filings.
